purpose: 111 CURRENT FIRST-SOURCE PENDING PRODUCT-BY-PRODUCT POSITIVE IDENTITY RESEARCH ONLY; NO FALSE CTR PRODUCT TRANSFER

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: Children's supplements is not one standard finished chemical or food article.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Do not borrow infant formula or cereal metals without full finished product match.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Verify intended child age group, composition and applicable officially categorized supplement type.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: 2.3.37 frozen fruit is not a canned fruit metal article.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Do not transfer raw fruit pesticides without finished processing basis.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Prove botanical species, freezing process, edible portion and applicable exact article.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: 2.3.45 desiccated coconut is dry plant solid, not coconut oil.
records.prohibited_inheritance: No automatic coconut edible oil or unspecified nut aflatoxin article.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Establish its exact dried coconut commodity and relevant CTR subtype.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: 2.3.47(5) combines dried FRUITS and NUTS that may occupy different regulatory commodity articles.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Do not treat every nut as dried fruit nor whole fruit/nut as pulp.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Name plant species, drying and intended form, then prove exact candidate.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: Edible catechu under 2.11.2 is a distinct extract identity.
records.prohibited_inheritance: No automatic tea, caramel, colour or tannin extract CTR row.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Authenticate catechu source, extraction and direct FSSAI contaminant article.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: Pickles 2.3.43 include pieces in brine, oil, acid or sugar.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Raw-fruit pesticides and processed fruit pulp metal rows are not identical to pickle.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Prove named fruit, preservation medium and tested drained/as-sold basis.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: 2.3.1 heat-treated fruit includes different fruits and container forms.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Do not automatically borrow canned mango or canned tropical fruit salad.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Prove actual fruit species, hermetic canned state and named source.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: 2.3.25 Murabba is cooked and sweetened fruit/vegetable preserve.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Whole fresh fruit MRL or fruit-pulp metal row is not self-evidently a Murabba limit.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Show named raw species and specific preserve finished article.

records.product_name: Candied, Crystallised And Glazed Fruit / Vegetable / Rhizome / Fruit Peel
records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: 2.3.26 explicitly covers fruits, VEGETABLES, RHIZOMES and PEEL.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Fruit pulp metals cannot govern every vegetable and rhizome form.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Resolve botanical identity, part, candied medium, direct contaminant article.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: 2.3.49 seedless tamarind is not necessarily concentrated tamarind pulp.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Do not transfer canned fruit, generic fruit-pulp or raw fruit residues automatically.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Verify species, deseeding process, puree/pulp status and marketed test basis.

records.product_name: Edible Dried Seeds obtained from Fruits
records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: Fruit-derived dried seed is a taxonomic group, not one oilseed.
records.prohibited_inheritance: No general mustard, groundnut or grain toxicant article for every seed.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Identify botanical seed species and named source article.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: 2.3.38 frozen vegetables are distinct from dried and canned.
records.prohibited_inheritance: No canned or dried vegetable lead transfer.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Identify vegetable species, actual frozen state, sampling and processing.

records.product_name: Pickles made from vegetables or other edible plant material including mushrooms
records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: Pickle standard 2.3.43 PERMITS mushrooms but does not require them.
records.prohibited_inheritance: No automatic mushroom agaric-acid article in plant pickles.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Confirm mushroom inclusion/species and exact toxin article.

records.product_name: Pickles made from combination of fruits or vegetables or other edible plant material including mushrooms (Mixed)
records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: Mixed pickle may have zero mushrooms under 2.3.43.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Do not assume optional mushroom NOTS or canned mushroom article.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Confirm real formulation, species and pickling process.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: 2.3.3 vegetable processing covers diverse species and containers.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Do not equate all thermally processed vegetables with canned carrots.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Document vegetable species, thermal process, package and direct article.

records.product_name: Thermally processed Curried Vegetables/Ready to Eat Vegetables
records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: 2.3.4 curried ready-to-eat vegetables are multi-ingredient prepared foods.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Canned vegetable or dry vegetable metal articles do not universally apply.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Confirm recipe, canned versus pouch, drained or as-consumed basis.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: 2.3.28 ginger paste is a rhizome paste, not dried onion.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Do not inherit dehydrated onion or canned non-onion vegetable lead.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Verify ginger fraction, moisture and culinary paste article.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: 2.3.39 frozen prepared vegetables are distinct from canned and dried.
records.prohibited_inheritance: No direct canned vegetable, dried vegetable or raw vegetable transfer.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Prove vegetable subtype, recipe, freeze state and final matrix.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: 2.3.60 frozen fried potatoes are processed tuber food.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Cannot use dried vegetable lead as finished potato fries limit.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Confirm potato preparation, fry process and final contaminant test basis.

records.product_name: Edible Dried Seeds obtained from Vegetables
records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: Edible dried vegetable seeds are not uniquely mustard, grain or oilseed.
records.prohibited_inheritance: No one oilseed, pulses or cereal article covers all botanical seeds.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Prove individual seed species, edible material and matched article.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: Fruit/nut mouth freshener category does not imply hard-boiled sugar.
records.prohibited_inheritance: No automatic four metal rows for hard-boiled sugar confectionery.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Establish actual hard-boiled process or separate finished source.

records.product_name: Other traditional mouth fresheners not covered under 5.2.4.1 and 5.2.4.2
records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: Residual mouth freshener category includes diverse herbal/food forms.
records.prohibited_inheritance: No generic hard-boiled sugar confectionery identity.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Demonstrate specific composition, physical process and product article.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: 2.11.7 carob pod flour/powder is not cocoa powder.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Cocoa powder dry-fat-free Lead/Copper articles do not cover carob.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Prove carob identity and an explicitly matching legal contaminant row.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: 2.4.14 arrowroot is rhizome starch rather than grain.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Do not transfer milled food grains pesticide article.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Authenticate species, starch extraction and precise residue source.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: 2.3.64 Singharra flour comes from aquatic plant water chestnut.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Do not treat water chestnut flour as a cereal milled grain.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Confirm source species, tuber/corm status and exact CTR article.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: 2.5.2(14) casings are anatomical casing tissues, not cattle muscle.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Do not substitute muscle, liver, kidney veterinary residue basis.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Verify species, tissue, manufacture and legally applicable residue specimen.

records.product_name: Polyols permitted under Appendix-A of FSS(FPS&FA) Regulations,2011 excluding those already standardized
records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: Appendix A polyols consist of multiple distinct food additives.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Do not extend specific sorbitol Lead values to all polyols.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Determine each INS/CAS, individual purity and CTR source.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: 2.9.30(6) salt substitutes may have non-sodium salts.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Food grade NaCl salt Lead cannot be borrowed for all substitutes.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Document salts and chemical purity monograph and specific article.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: 2.3.28 culinary pastes may include fruit, vegetable, rhizome or mixed materials.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Do not equate wet paste with dried non-onion vegetables.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Confirm botanical source, wet/dry form, package and named article.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: FoSCoS Category 18 starch sweets are not necessarily hard-boiled sugar candies.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Version IX Lead 2, Copper 5, Arsenic 1, Tin 5 mg/kg are hard-boiled candy reference rows only.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Prove actual hard-boiled sugar finished article before any four-metal application.

records.product_name: Dry Fruit and nuts based Sweets
records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: Fruit/nut confection does not necessarily use hard-boiled sugar cooking.
records.prohibited_inheritance: No automatic metal limits of hard-boiled sugar.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Specify fruit/nut species, sweet manufacturing process and actual source.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: Fruit/vegetable sweets may be pulp products, cooked jams or other confections.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Do not assume hard-boiled candy or fruit-pulp metal article.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Resolve the actual raw material and finished process type.

records.product_name: Cereal or pulses flour/ Starch based snacks & savouries
records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: FoSCoS route permits cereals OR pulses OR tuber-derived starch.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Do not assign milled grain MRL to all finished snacks.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Prove principal commodity and supported processing-factor residue rule.

records.product_name: Fruit and vegetable based snacks & savouries
records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: Fruit/vegetable snack is not necessarily hard-boiled sugar confectionery.
records.prohibited_inheritance: No hard-boiled sugar metal row from sweet/snack categorization.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Prove exact species and final product process.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: Food additive premix combines separate INS compounds, carriers and solvents.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Do not reuse purity limit of any one constituent for the whole mixture.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Identify full additive INS formula and official applicable constituent/product basis.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: 3.3.4 trehalose disaccharide is distinct from refined sucrose and dried glucose.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Neither refined white sugar nor high-ash starch syrup article automatically covers trehalose.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Find exactly named trehalose contamination/purity standard.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: Sajji Khar is not one assumed sodium additive without chemistry.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Do not borrow NaHCO3 or NaOH impurity limits by synonym.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Establish chemical composition and relevant monograph/article.

records.product_name: Additives permitted under Appendix-A of FSS (FPS&FA) Regulations, 2011 and other food safety standards regulations excluding those already standardized and additives of Nutraceutical Regulations
records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: Appendix A category is a family of chemically unrelated INS additives.
records.prohibited_inheritance: No universal citric acid, color or stabilizer metal article.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Establish each ingredient INS/CAS and precise purity/CTR source.

records.product_name: Additives VA-VF of Nutraceutical Regulations excluding those already standardised
records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: VA-VF nutraceutical additives form multiple chemical/supply classes.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Do not use a general conventional-food additive impurity row for all.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Confirm particular schedule, substance, INS and individual metal article.

records.product_name: Permitted enzymes and their preparations excluding those already listed under Processing Aids and Nutraceutical Regulations
records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: Enzyme preparations may include fermentation broths, carriers or powders.
records.prohibited_inheritance: No universal enzymes metal article inferred from one carrier.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Identify enzyme EC/activity, source organism, process and legally applicable preparation.

records.product_name: Ingredients listed under Schedule IV, Schedule VI and Schedule VIII of Nutraceutical Regulations
records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: Schedule IV/VI/VIII nutraceutical ingredients vary widely in identity.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Schedule membership does not establish a unique contaminant limit.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Identify exact botanical/chemical ingredient and applicable source.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: Functional ingredient premix is a mixture, not a singular finished chemical.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Do not borrow one component's named contaminant value as a premix result.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Prove formula, carrier and relevant finished-food regulatory category.

records.product_name: Cow or Buffalo Colostrum and Colostrum Products
records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: 2.1.23 colostrum and its products cover early milk secretion and processed variants.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Normal Milk Lead dehydration factor does not automatically represent all colostrum products.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Separate liquid, dried and mixed colostrum formula and authoritative CTR article.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: 2.8.3(3) royal jelly is glandular bee secretion, not honey or beeswax.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Do not inherit honey/beeswax metals or botanical residues.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Find royal-jelly-specific source or prove official bee-product grouping.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: 2.11.4 silver leaf has material identity/purity requirements, not food dye identity.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Do not borrow food colour, lake or gold leaf metal standards.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Document silver composition/impurity source and specific CTR article.

records.affirmative_product_identity_or_scope: 2.11.8 soluble dextrin fibre is not dried glucose syrup or table sugar.
records.prohibited_inheritance: Do not borrow refined sugar or high-ash syrup metal values.
records.missing_affirmative_ctr_evidence: Confirm manufacture, molecular form and exact fibre contaminant article.
